import subprocess
from pathlib import Path

iso=Path("/Users/steventran/.do_again/selfdev-20261007")
orig=Path("/Users/steventran/do-again")

def run(cwd,args,check=True):
    return subprocess.run(args,cwd=cwd,text=True,capture_output=True,check=check)

print("=== isolated ===")
print("branch="+run(iso,["git","branch","--show-current"]).stdout.strip())
print("head="+run(iso,["git","rev-parse","HEAD"]).stdout.strip())
print("status:")
print(run(iso,["git","status","--porcelain=v1"]).stdout)
print("ci.yml:")
print((iso/".github/workflows/ci.yml").read_text())

print("=== original checkout READ ONLY ===")
print("branch="+run(orig,["git","branch","--show-current"]).stdout.strip())
print("head="+run(orig,["git","rev-parse","HEAD"]).stdout.strip())
print("status:")
print(run(orig,["git","status","--porcelain=v1"]).stdout)
print("diffstat:")
print(run(orig,["git","diff","--stat"]).stdout)

for rel in [
    "src/do_again/cli.py",
    "src/do_again/service/daemon.py",
    "src/do_again/service/liveness.py",
    "tests/test_liveness.py",
]:
    p=orig/rel
    print(f"=== {rel} exists={p.exists()} ===")
    if not p.exists():
        continue
    if rel in {"src/do_again/service/liveness.py","tests/test_liveness.py"}:
        print(p.read_text())
    else:
        diff=run(orig,["git","diff","--",rel],check=False)
        print(diff.stdout)

print("=== focused liveness test names ===")
if (orig/"tests/test_liveness.py").exists():
    for line in (orig/"tests/test_liveness.py").read_text().splitlines():
        if line.lstrip().startswith("def test_"):
            print(line.strip())
